t.t-value: ('Final Sign-Off — ' if is_final else 'Task Approval — ') + (task.name or '')

t.p: Our team has finished this. Please check it on your side, then tap Finished, or send it back and write what is still wrong. If we don't hear back by , we'll close it.

textarea.name: feedback
textarea.t-att-placeholder: 'What is still wrong? (needed to send it back)' if is_final else 'Comment (optional — required for Reject / Clarify)'

div.div: Optional: show the problem with photos, a screen video or a voice note (up to 10 files, 50 MB each). They go with Send back only.

form.p: Please write what is still wrong (or your question) in the box above.

t.p:
Thanks — your decision has been recorded.
You can close this tab.

This task was already decided.
Reach out to the team if you need this revised.

p.t-esc: meta or 'This approval link can no longer be used.'

p.style: background:#f8f9fa; padding:12px; border-radius:10px; border-left: 3px solid #dc3545; font-size:14px;

p.t-esc: hint or 'Please ask the team to send a fresh link.'
